remediation_tasks.suggested_action: Review declared purpose against privacy policy and obtain Data Protection Officer sign-off in the Inventory workspace.
remediation_tasks.expected_benefit: Confirms legal alignment between technical collection and corporate privacy commitments.

remediation_tasks.title: Assess Cross-System Data Duplication & Minimization
remediation_tasks.reason: Data class 'GOVERNMENT_ID' is duplicated across multiple datasets. Redundant data stores expand potential attack surface.
remediation_tasks.suggested_action: Conduct data minimization audit to evaluate if centralized reference tokenization can replace duplicate column storage.
remediation_tasks.expected_benefit: Reduces compliance footprint and limits blast radius during potential data security incidents.
